subject: Coord: Veridian security review & procurement alignment
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@veridian.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@veridian.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Security review request — Veridian x Redwood

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're moving toward an internal procurement decision and need a short, focused security review with Redwood before we finalize next steps. Attendees on our side will be me (security lead), Tom Reed (platform eng lead), and one person from procurement. We'd like the session to cover:
- SOC 2 scope and evidence mapping
- Data flow and retention for embeddings
- Network/VPC options for private deployment
- Export controls & data residency

Would you be able to propose 2–3 60-minute slots next week? Procurement prefers afternoons PT, but security is flexible. I attached the questionnaire our security team filled out to give context.

Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Security, Veridian.ai
olivia.park@veridian.ai

Attachment: veridian-security-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 92KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@veridian.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@veridian.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security review request — Veridian x Redwood

Hi Olivia — great to hear and thanks for sending the questionnaire. Looping in Marcus (SE) and Vivek (infosec/compliance) from our team.

Proposed 60-minute slots (all PT):
- Tue Oct 6, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Oct 7, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Oct 8, 10:00–11:00

Pre-reads we'll provide: SOC 2 summary (redacted), network diagram, brief note on data retention defaults. Could you confirm whether procurement needs an explicit PO/contract discussion in the same call or a follow-up? If procurement would prefer a separate short call, we can schedule that immediately after.

Agenda I suggest: 5m intros / 40m scoping + Q&A / 10m procurement next steps / 5m wrap. I've attached a one-pager agenda for the session.

If those slots don't work, tell us your top two and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Office: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: security-review-agenda.pdf (pdf, 18KB)

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@veridian.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@veridian.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@veridian.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security review request — Veridian x Redwood

Neha / Olivia — procurement here. We prefer Thu Oct 8 afternoon PT but can make Thu 10:00–11:00 work if that is the only option. Ideally procurement joins to surface contract/PO timing and any legal redlines. If possible, please include:
- High-level pricing/commitment model for dedicated capacity (for our SRE budget)
- Contracting lead or legal POC so we have someone to follow up with

Also, we typically ask for a short NDA before sharing a few sensitive config documents — will Redwood sign our standard mutual NDA (I can attach)? If you prefer, we can do the procurement discussion in a 15-minute follow-up after the security portion.

Thanks,
Tom Reed
Platform Engineering Lead, Veridian.ai
tom.reed@veridian.ai

Attachment: (none)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@veridian.ai>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@veridian.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security review request — Veridian x Redwood

Hi all — Marcus here (Solutions Engineering). Quick notes on scope from our side so the call is productive:
- We'll demo the minimal data flow for embeddings, including KV cache behavior and optional prefix caching.
- Cover hosting options: hosted API, Dedicated (VPC), and Private (on-prem image).
- SOC 2 evidence: we can provide a redacted summary during the call and share the full SOC 2 artifacts under NDA.

I'm attaching our SOC 2 summary and a lightweight networking diagram. If you can confirm whether you want a combined session or separate procurement follow-up, we'll hold the appropriate folks.

Proposed dial-in: Zoom (link will be in the calendar invite).

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf, 210KB)
Attachment: networking-architecture-diagram.png (png, 340KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@veridian.ai>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@veridian.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security review request — Veridian x Redwood

Following up from our side — I can take the compliance portion and address SOC 2 scope, audit cadence, and our data handling guarantees. Small scheduling note: I have a compliance committee at 10:00am on Thu Oct 8; could we shift the session to Thu Oct 8, 11:00–12:00 PT instead? That would also allow Tessa to join for procurement escalation if needed.

If that works, Neha, can you send the calendar invite with Zoom and include a slide deck placeholder (we'll attach the pre-reads before the call)?

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachment: networking-architecture-diagram.png (png, 340KB)

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@veridian.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@veridian.ai>, procurement <procurement@veridian.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security review request — Veridian x Redwood

Thanks — Thu Oct 8, 11:00–12:00 PT works for us. Procurement will be on the hangout; I'll ask our contracts lead to drop any NDA as a pre-read if possible.

Please go ahead and send the calendar invite with Zoom link and attach the SOC 2 summary and the agenda. Also, can procurement loop me in on PO/contract next steps after the call?

Olivia
